title: Childhood homes and his father's name
summary: Barnes lists where he grew up, starting on Claiborne and moving to Lauderd and Poot Streets, and says his father shared his name.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I wanted to ask you, let's see, you said you were born on Claiborne Street?
Claiborne Avenue? I was born in, uh, in Climbit.
And did you grow up in that house?
No, I probably just grew up to, uh, to Lauderd Street, about seven, eight years old.
What was your father's name? Did he, he lived there in that house?
Same, it's the same as my name.
That's right. But all the trouble, he was like Paul, he got Daniel.
That's where Paul is, Paul Daniel. You see?
So you each got a piece of his name. And, uh, after you moved from there, where did you move to?
Well, when we moved from there, we moved to the Poot Street. And Poot and what?
Poot between the building and, uh, Robert.
And how old were you, uh, while you were living there?
Well, I lived in there? Well, I don't know, I think I stood there maybe about two or three years.
Was that short pants or long pants?
